body.name: branch-free semialgebraic inverse
body.construction: \(\mathcal R_n=\{(A,D):\exists(M_0,M_1)\in\mathcal C_n^M(\alpha),\ M_0\succ0,\ M_1=A^mM_0,\ M_0=A^mM_0(A^m)^\top+\sum_{r=0}^{m-1}A^rD(A^r)^\top,\ A_{ij}=0\text{ for }i<j,\ A_{ij}=0\text{ for }i>j\text{ with }j\to i\notin G,\ \max_i|A_{ii}|\le1-\gamma,\ \max_{i,j}|A_{ij}|\le L,\ D_{ij}=0\text{ for }i\ne j,\ d_{\min}I_d\preceq D\preceq d_{\max}I_d\}\).
